members.author: AydarAkhmetzyanov
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2666: Both fix the same race condition in streamable_http.py's post_writer: the task group spawns post_writer and the surrounding function yields control to the caller (or starts the GET stream) before post_writer has actually entered its read loop, so a message written to write_stream immediately after can be missed/dropped. clusters.pick_reason: #2565 fixes the same raise sites with a strictly minimal diff — it only appends `from e` and leaves the existing f-string error messages (e.g. 'Invalid registration response: {e}') unchanged. #2777 additionally rewrites those messages to drop the interpolated exception detail (e.g. to plain 'Invalid registration response'), which changes the exception's string content beyond the stated chaining fix and risks breaking any code/tests that assert on the message text. Keeping #2565 gets the exception-chaining fix without that extra, unrelated behavior change.
